hints.title: Turn products into sums
hints.body: Use log(uv)=logu+logv and log(ur)=rlogu. Set A=loga, B=logb, C=logc. The first equation becomes A+2B+C=7.
hints.recap: Logarithm laws can turn multiplicative equations into linear equations.
hints.pitfall: Logs of products are sums of logs, not products of logs.
hints.pause: Translate the other two equations using the same three letters.

recall.reminder: Every logarithm uses the same base, so the product and power laws apply consistently.

hints.title: Eliminate the terms you do not need
hints.body: The equations are A+2B+C=7, 2A+B+2C=11 and 2A+2B+3C=15. Subtract the second from the third to obtain B+C=4. Subtract twice the first from the third to obtain −2B+C=1.
hints.recap: Subtracting whole equations eliminates a shared coefficient.
hints.pitfall: When subtracting twice an equation, double every term and the right-hand side.
hints.pause: Subtract these last two equations to find <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><mrow><mi>B</mi></mrow></math>.

recall.reminder: Renaming expressions lets ordinary elimination solve the hidden system.

hints.title: Interpret your solved logarithms
hints.body: After solving the linear system, use the definition <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><mrow><msub><mi>log</mi><mi>k</mi></msub><mi>t</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>r</mi><mi>⟺</mi><msup><mi>k</mi><mi>r</mi></msup><mo>=</mo><mi>t</mi></mrow></math> to interpret the values obtained.
hints.recap: A logarithm describes an exponent relative to its base.
hints.pitfall: Do not confuse the value of a logarithm with the original number.
hints.pause: Determine which original quantity, if any, equals the common base.

recall.reminder: A logarithm describes an exponent relative to its base.

solution:
Put A=loga, B=logb and C=logc. The three equations become A+2B+C=7, 2A+B+2C=11, 2A+2B+3C=15.

Subtracting the second from the third gives B+C=4. Subtracting twice the first from the third gives −2B+C=1. Hence 3B=3 and B=1.

Thus logkb=1 for the common base k, so k=b. The remaining values are A=2 and C=3, consistent with a=b2 and c=b3. Answer B.
knowledgePattern: Solve for logarithms and recognise which variable equals the base
